requirements.summary: A modern landing page hero section featuring a staggered, smooth slide-up entrance animation on page load. The layout consists of a top navigation bar, a split-column hero area with a text card on the left and a UI showcase on the right, followed by a logo strip.
requirements.template_goal: Create a reusable, animated hero template where the entrance sequence is controlled by CSS classes or a simple animation library. The split layout should be easily configurable for different content types.
hard_constraints: The page must load with a blank state and animate elements in sequentially.
The hero section must use a two-column layout on desktop.
The left hero card must have a distinct background color and large rounded corners.
The right hero section must contain overlapping or staggered UI cards over a colored background container.
Animations must use a smooth ease-out timing function.

typography: Heading Font: Serif (e.g., Merriweather, Playfair Display) for main hero text and logo.
Body Font: Sans-serif (e.g., Inter, Roboto) for navigation, body copy, and buttons.
spacing: Container Max Width: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
Grid Gap: gap-8 or gap-12 between hero columns
shadows: UI Card Shadow: shadow-lg or shadow-xl with soft spread
motion: Default Easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) or Tailwind ease-out
Slide Distance: translateY(30px) for bottom-up, translateY(-20px) for top-down

section_requirements.name: Header
section_requirements.purpose: Top navigation and primary call to action.
section_requirements.layout: Flexbox, space-between, items-center. Nav links centered.
must_include: Navigation Links (About, Case Studies, Resources, What We Offer)
styling: Transparent background initially, fixed or sticky top.
Logo uses serif font, dark green.
Nav links use sans-serif, dark text, with dropdown indicators for some.
Button uses dark green background, white text, rounded-full.
behaviors: Animates in from top on load.

section_requirements.name: Hero Section
section_requirements.purpose: Main value proposition and visual showcase.
section_requirements.layout: CSS Grid, 2 columns (1fr 1fr) on desktop, 1 column on mobile. Gap between columns.
styling: Left Card: Light green background, rounded-3xl, p-12 flex flex-col justify-between.
Right Container: Light blue/grey background, rounded-3xl, p-8 relative.
Main Heading: Serif, very large (text-6xl+), dark green.
Body Text: Sans-serif, text-lg, dark green/grey.
Left Button: Dark green background, white text, rounded-full, flex items-center gap-2.
copy_items: Admit more patients, reduce staff burden, and get paid faster with an AI-native system built for behavioral healthcare.
assets: 3x UI Mockup Images/Cards for the right side

section_requirements.name: Logo Strip
section_requirements.layout: Flexbox column for heading, then flex row wrap for logos. Centered.
styling: Heading: text-sm, font-semibold, uppercase tracking-wider, text-gray-500, mb-6 text-center.
Logos: Grayscale or muted, flex justify-center gap-8 items-center opacity-70.
behaviors: Slides up and fades in after hero section.

layout_requirements: Use a max-width container to constrain the main content.
Implement a responsive grid for the hero section: 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on desktop.
Ensure the left hero card stretches to match the height of the right container if necessary, or align them to the top.
styling_requirements: Apply large border radii (rounded-3xl) to the main hero background shapes.
Use a serif font for the main 'Fewer clicks. More care.' heading to match the reference.
Ensure high contrast for text on the light green background.
copy_requirements: Use exact copy from the reference video for the hero heading and subheading.
asset_requirements: Mock the UI cards on the right side using HTML/CSS (white background, shadow, rounded-xl, placeholder content) if actual images are not available, to maintain the layout structure.
behavior_requirements: The entire page must start invisible (opacity-0) and animate in.
Hover states on buttons should slightly darken the background or scale up.
animation_requirements: Initial State: All animated elements have opacity: 0 and transform: translateY(30px) (or -20px for header).
Timeline 0.2s: Header logo and 'Book a Demo' button slide down (translateY(-20px) to 0) and fade in.
Timeline 0.4s: Header nav links fade in.
Timeline 0.6s: Left hero card background and right hero container background slide up (translateY(30px) to 0) and fade in.
Timeline 0.8s: Left hero text ('Fewer clicks...') slides up and fades in.
Timeline 1.0s: Left 'Request a Demo' button and Right UI cards slide up and fade in.
Timeline 1.2s: Logo strip heading and logos slide up and fade in.
Easing: Use a smooth ease-out function (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)) with a duration of 700ms-1000ms per element.
structure_guidance: Use a wrapper div for the animation context, potentially utilizing a library like Framer Motion (if React) or Alpine.js/vanilla JS with CSS classes for the staggered delays.

execution_plan: 1. Setup the base HTML structure and Tailwind configuration, including custom colors and fonts (Serif/Sans).
2. Build the Header component with flexbox layout.
3. Build the Hero section grid layout (2 columns).
4. Style the Left Hero Card (green background, rounded corners, typography).
5. Style the Right Hero Container (blue/grey background) and create the 3 overlapping UI mockup cards using absolute positioning or flexbox within the container.
7. Implement the animation sequence. Define CSS classes for the initial state (`opacity-0 translate-y-8`) and the final state (`opacity-100 translate-y-0 transition-all duration-700 ease-out`).
8. Apply staggered transition delays to the elements according to the animation requirements.
known_unknowns: The exact font families used (Serif and Sans-serif). Will use standard web-safe alternatives like Merriweather and Inter.
The exact content of the UI mockup cards on the right. Will use structural placeholders that mimic the layout.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Header Reveal
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: Logo and top right button slide down into view.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Hero Backgrounds Reveal
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: The large green and blue/grey background shapes slide up into view.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Hero Content Reveal
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: Text, buttons, and UI cards slide up into their respective containers.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Logo Strip Reveal
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: The investor logos appear at the bottom of the screen.

acceptance_criteria: The page layout matches the two-column hero design on desktop.
The specific background colors (light green, light blue/grey) and large border radii are applied to the hero containers.
The entrance animation plays automatically on load, following the staggered sequence described.
The typography uses a distinct serif font for the main heading and logo, and sans-serif elsewhere.
The layout is responsive, stacking the hero columns on smaller screens.

validation.summary: The candidate implementation is excellent. It perfectly captures the layout, styling, and complex staggered animation sequence described in the requirements and visible in the reference video. The use of CSS variables for animation configuration and a JS object for content makes the template highly editable and robust.
strengths: Perfect execution of the staggered entrance animation sequence with correct delays and easing.
High visual fidelity to the reference design, including colors, typography, and layout proportions.
Excellent structural implementation of the staggered UI cards using CSS transforms.
Highly editable code structure with a dedicated configuration object for copy and assets.
